name: match-highlight
title: Match highlight
description: Marks the part of a string that matches a search with a real mark element, ignoring case and accents, with several terms and no regular expression to break.
docs: The query is matched as plain text, so typing a bracket never throws. "cafe" marks Café and cafetière; caseSensitive and accentSensitive turn either off. Pass an array of terms to mark each of them, and markClassName to restyle the mark.
